text:
lee (partnerships): Quick sync — Marvell EAP bench plan. Raj will join later today. Need to confirm NDA scope, shipping, and which perf vectors we run. TL;DR: boards next week, 2 main runs (latency p95, steady throughput), plus KV cache correctness checks.

raj (marvell): Hi all — thanks for coordinating. NDA was uploaded from our side this morning. We can ship two evaluation boards (A and B) next Wednesday. Confirm address and any customs paperwork. Our target is to run a short LLM inference suite you provide.

lee (partnerships): Shipping address: Redwood Inference, 420 Forge St, San Francisco, CA 94107. Emily — can legal confirm NDA redlines are acceptable? Also we'll need an ETA for tracking once shipped.

emily (legal): I reviewed the NDA PDF. Section 4.2 needs a minor redaction (data retention wording). Raj — can Marvell accept redaction for that clause? If yes, we can sign on our side today.

raj (marvell): Section 4.2 redaction is acceptable. We can sign once you return an exec-signed copy. We'll attach the signed copy to the tracker.

sarah (eng-ml): For the bench list I propose: 1) Latency (single-stream) at 4096 tokens, batch=1 — report p50/p95/p99. 2) Throughput sustained (concurrent streams/batching) up to batch=8 for steady-state. 3) KV-cache long-context correctness (run >64k tokens to validate KV eviction). We'll run with model tag rdx-3b-q4.

praveen (eng-runtime): We'll deploy our runtime in your environment. Suggested runner command for Marvell adapter:
```
docker run --rm -e MODEL=rdx-3b-q4 -p 8080:8080 redwood/runtime:latest \
  --enable-batching --max-batch-size=8 --kv-cache
```
Also need the board image/firmware details and libc/runtime compatibility. Raj, what container runtime and firmware version are on the eval boards?

raj (marvell): Boards run Marvell-ML firmware 2.1 and our marvell-rt runtime v1.4. Not CUDA-based; it's our own accelerator runtime. We'll provide a small adapter container (musl-based) that exposes a compatible gRPC endpoint. We'll also send driver/firmware checksums and a minimal validation script.

sarah (eng-ml): Adapter is fine. Please include perf counters (latency histograms, token/sec), driver firmware hash, and power draw samples if available. We'll run:
```
./bench.sh --model rdx-3b-q4 --seq 4096 --batch 1 --out perf_run1.json
```
We do 3 runs and share median.

praveen (eng-runtime): Add to that: runtime git hash, container image digest, and the exact command used to start the server. We'll want deterministic reproductions. We'll store runs under redwood/bench/marvell/<date>.

nadia (product): Quick note on comms — no external announcements until we agree on joint messaging. We'll prepare a draft one-pager for signoff. Also want to capture qualitative notes (latency variance, degradation modes) for product-teammates.

emily (legal): Confirming embargo: both parties agree no public statements until joint press signoff. We'll attach an embargo clause to the run report template.

lee (partnerships): Proposed timeline: NDA signed today -> Marvell ships Wed 2026-04-06 -> Redwood bench Thurs/Fri 2026-04-07/08 -> internal sync Mon 2026-04-11 for initial feedback and go/no-go on extended eval. Please flag any blockers.

praveen (eng-runtime): We'll need kernel headers and any special device node creation steps in advance. Raj — can you provide a pre-shipment checklist (drivers, firmware, runtime image, adapter image, validation script)?

raj (marvell): Yes — will provide a tarball with driver/firmware checksums, adapter image (OCI), and validation script. Also include `run_validation.sh` that outputs a simple JSON with counters.

sarah (eng-ml): For results: we want raw perf.json, the adapter logs, and a short reproduction README. Also a note if batching/fusing altered output tokens (sanity check).

marvell-ci-bot: Tracking update: shipping ticket MV-2345 opened, ETA 2026-04-06, tracking will be posted once label printed.

lee (partnerships): Action items: 1) Emily finalize NDA redline and return signed copy (Emily). 2) Raj send pre-shipment tarball + tracking when available (Raj). 3) Praveen prepare runtime image and repro script (Praveen). 4) Sarah prepare bench harness and example invocations (Sarah). 5) Nadia draft joint messaging template & embargo note (Nadia). We'll reconvene here once tracking is up. :thumbsup:

raj (marvell): All set from our side on the plan. Will follow up with tarball and signed NDA today. Thanks all.

lee (partnerships): Great — will post updated timeline + tracking once I have the signed NDA and shipment number.
